title: Mushroom Toasts with Goat Cheese, Balsamic & Thyme

steps.text: Peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms and shallot; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms begin to soften, about 4 minutes.
Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry thyme. Slide leaves off the stems; discard the stems.
Add garlic, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook, stirring often, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Place bread slices on top of a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, 2-3 minutes, or until toasted. Remove from the oven.
Spread goat cheese over toast and top with warm mushrooms.
To serve, divide toasts between dishes and garnish with thyme. Enjoy!
